text:
A point apiece does little to boost either side, but while Parma saw a penalty saved, Udinese had by far the most chances to win in this relegation dogfight.
This was an unexpectedly tense situation for both clubs, locked together on just four points after eight rounds. Alberto Gilardino lost all three games in charge since taking over from Carlos Cuesta, but the only remaining absentee was Nesta Elphege after having his appendix taken out. There was a change in goal, Giovanni Daffara given his Serie A debut.
The Friulani lost six on the bounce and coach Kosta Runjaic was hanging by a thread. Nicolò Zaniolo made his return to the field last week in a 2-0 defeat to Milan, but Oumar Solet, Alessandro Zanoli, David Alaba, Vakoun Bayo and Idrissa Gueye were still struggling with fitness issues.
Zaniolo almost scored in his first start for well over a month, as he juggled the ball with a bit of skill and then bent the curling finish inches past the far top corner.
The visitors threatened repeatedly, as Hassane Kamara fired just wide after good work from Keinan Davis, while Jesper Karlstrom also drilled not far off target.
Udinese had strong penalty appeals rejected after Mariano Troilo and Davis got into a wrestling match in the six-yard box with the cross coming in.
Franco Carboni couldn’t keep his header down on the Sascha Britschgi cross, while Nicolò Bertola’s deflected effort forced Daffara into a tricky save at full stretch.
Udinese continued to have the better of the game and on the hour mark Troilo flung himself in the path of a Davis strike from 12 yards, deflecting it inches wide with Daffara beaten.
Parma were gifted an opportunity to take the lead when Maduka Okoye fumbled a corner and the Troilo shot was charged down by James Abankwah’s arm. However, Adrian Bernabé stepped up and saw his penalty parried by Okoye, making up for the earlier error.
Udinese pushed to the end, as Jurgen Ekkelenkamp had come sliding in to meet the cross from five yards and beat the goalkeeper, but Troilo got back for a decisive goal-line clearance.
Moments later, Daffara denied Unai Gomez from point-blank range at the back post.

משחק מתח גבוה בתחתית הסריה א הסתיים בתיקו מאופס בין פארמה לאודינזה, תוצאה שלא הועברה משמעותית לאף אחת מהקבוצות שנמצאות בפתיחת עונה קשה. אודינזה הגיעה ליותר מצבים לאורך ההתמודדות ואיימה על השער מספר פעמים באמצעות שחקניה, בעוד פארמה קיבלה הזדמנות פז לעלות ליתרון לאחר ששוער היריבה שמט כדור והוביל לפסיקת בעיטת עונשין מן הנקודה הלבנה. אולם, אדריאן ברנבה בעט את הפנלטי והשוער הדף את הכדור בהצלחה.

המשחק המשיך בקצב מהיר כאשר אודינזה לחצה עד השניות האחרונות בניסיון להכריע את ההתמודדות, אך הגנת פארמה והשוער ג'ובאני דאפארה הצליחו להדוף את האיומים, כולל הצלת כדור מהקו בתוספת הזמן. בסיום, שתי הקבוצות נאלצו להסתפק בנקודה בודדת בלבד הותירו את המצב בתחתית סבוך.
